notCovered: Every one of the 18 tools is called. Not reached inside them: sheet_import with replace: true into a filled sheet; sheet_format width / height / color; a scatter chart; sheet_table with owner / property / at / units given; a cyclic dependency between cells (FreeCAD leaves such cells unevaluated and prints a console line; the refusal's wording for it is from source, not seen live); VarSet variables read through a variant Link (the CopyOnChange status now set on the switch as FreeCAD's dialog does, tutorial steps 12-19, needs a Link or SubShapeBinder made by other families' tools).
